# Architecture Pass

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

> The Awtsmoos renews every frame; the architecture must let Awtsmoos.com share one movie language while every editor keeps its own face and flame.

## Chosen architecture

Use `apps/shared/movie` as a canonical declarative movie protocol, never as a replacement editor. Animator remains character/camera/world authoring, Mitzvah Studio remains spatial 3D authoring, Nesher remains nonlinear editing/export, and Video Editor remains media/timeline oriented. Each app consumes or emits the same movie document through adapters.

## Runtime proof seam

Add a collision-safe `runtime/` package beneath the shared movie package. It samples active scenes and keyframes, paints every canonical visual kind to a deterministic Canvas-compatible frame, and exposes a renderer independent of app-specific DOM. The deterministic painter is the verification renderer and offline-export source; native app renderers remain preferred for product-specific fidelity.

## File split

- `runtime/MovieSceneSampler.js`: active scene, local time, layer transform sampling.
- `runtime/CanvasWorldPainter.js`: world/model/light depth and camera-angle visual grammar.
- `runtime/CanvasGraphicPainter.js`: shapes, paths, charts, text, tutorial overlays.
- `runtime/CanvasCharacterPainter.js`: 2D/3D people and motion poses.
- `runtime/CanvasParticlePainter.js`: deterministic seeded particles.
- `runtime/CanvasMovieRenderer.js`: orchestration only.
- `runtime/index.js`: runtime exports.
- `tools/renderThreeMinuteMovie.mjs`: offline encoded proof driver.

## Invariants

All source files remain under 120 lines, use tabs, stay unminified, and begin with B\"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He. Existing dirty app files are not rewritten in this pass.
